Name: CUBEID
Description: Internal ID for cube

Name: CUBEIDPUB
Description: Public cube ID

Name: CUBENAME
Description: Name of blue cube file

Name: CATID
Description: Catalog ID from Bryant et al. 2015 and Owers et al. 2017

Name: PA_STELKIN
Description: Kinematic position angle. Anticlockwise, North=0 degrees

Name: PA_STELKIN_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on the kinematic position angle

Name: SIGMA_RE
Description: Velocity dispersion from Re Sersic aperture spectra

Name: SIGMA_RE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on sigma_re

Name: SIGMA_3KPC_ROUND
Description: Velocity dispersion from 3kpc aperture spectra

Name: SIGMA_3KPC_ROUND_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on sigma_3kpc

Name: SIGMA_1_4_ARCSECOND
Description: Velocity dispersion from 1.4 arcsec aperture spectra

Name: SIGMA_1_4_ARCSECOND_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on sigma_1_4_arcsec

Name: SIGMA_2_ARCSECOND
Description: Velocity dispersion from 2 arcsec aperture spectra

Name: SIGMA_2_ARCSECOND_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on sigma_2_arcsec

Name: SIGMA_3_ARCSECOND
Description: Velocity dispersion from 3 arcsec aperture spectra

Name: SIGMA_3_ARCSECOND_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on sigma_3_arcsec

Name: SIGMA_4_ARCSECOND
Description: Velocity dispersion from 4 arcsec aperture spectra

Name: SIGMA_4_ARCSECOND_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on sigma_4_arcsec

Name: APER_CORR_FLAG
Description: Flag to indicate whether lambdar_re and vsigma_re have been aperture corrected. 0 = no aperture correction applied. 1 = inside-out aperture corrected (rmax < re). 2 = from outside in (re < hwhm_psf)

Name: RMAX_APER_CORR
Description: Radius at which the aperture corrected value was determined from

Name: LAMBDAR_RE
Description: Spin Parameter proxy within effective ellipse as defined in van de Sande et al. 2017

Name: LAMBDAR_RE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on lambdar_re

Name: LAMBDAR_MAX
Description: Lambdar at maximum radius that is used for aperture correction (where APER_CORR_FLAG = 1)

Name: LAMBDAR_MAX_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on lambdar_Max

Name: VSIGMA_RE
Description: Flux weighted V/sigma within Re effective ellipse

Name: VSIGMA_RE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on vsigma_e

Name: VSIGMA_MAX
Description: V/sigma at maximum radius that is used for aperture correction (where APER_CORR_FLAG = 1)

Name: VSIGMA_MAX_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on VSigma_max

Name: MEAN_K51_RE
Description: kinematic asymmetry estimate from kinemetry within Re

Name: MEAN_K51_RE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on mean_k51_re

Name: SIGMA_RE_MGE
Description: Velocity dispersion from MGE Re aperture spectra

Name: SIGMA_RE_MGE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on sigma_re_mge

Name: APER_CORR_FLAG_MGE
Description: Flag to indicate whether lambdar_re_mge and vsigma_re_mge have been aperture corrected. 0 = no aperture correction applied. 1 = inside-out aperture corrected (rmax < MGE re). 2 = from outside in (re < hwhm_psf)

Name: RMAX_APER_CORR_MGE
Description: MGE relative Radius at which the aperture corrected value was determined from

Name: LAMBDAR_RE_MGE
Description: Spin Parameter proxy within MGE effective ellipse as defined in van de Sande et al. 2017

Name: LAMBDAR_RE_MGE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on lambdar_re_mge

Name: LAMBDAR_MAX_MGE
Description: MGE Lambdar at maximum radius that is used for aperture correction (where APER_CORR_FLAG_MGE = 1)

Name: LAMBDAR_MAX_MGE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on lambdar_Max_mge

Name: VSIGMA_RE_MGE
Description: Flux weighted V/sigma within MGE Re effective ellipse

Name: VSIGMA_RE_MGE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on vsigma_e_mge

Name: VSIGMA_MAX_MGE
Description: MGE V/sigma at maximum radius that is used for aperture correction (where APER_CORR_FLAG_MGE = 1)

Name: VSIGMA_MAX_MGE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on VSigma_max_mge

Name: MEAN_K51_RE_MGE
Description: kinematic asymmetry estimate from kinemetry within MGE Re

Name: MEAN_K51_RE_MGE_ERR
Description: 1-sigma error on mean_k51_re_mge
